notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch, no proxy needed. robots.txt checked: no Claude-specific full-site Disallow. Found via homepage mega-menu flyout tiles (e.g. the Art department flyout shows a 'New Arrivals' promo tile) and confirmed on the /sitemap/ index page. Root PLP https://www.1stdibs.com/new-arrivals/ opened and confirmed genuine: og:title 'New Arrivals - For Sale at 1stDibs', rendered header 'Search within 15,766 results', and embedded JSON totalResults:15766 all agree - a real browsable/sortable product grid, not editorial. The site exposes real department-level children of New Arrivals (linked directly from nav flyouts and the /new-arrivals/ page itself): Furniture, Art, Jewelry, Fashion. Each was opened and independently confirmed as a genuine PLP (matching og:title pattern 'New Arrivals: <Dept> - N,NNN For Sale at 1stDibs', rendered 'Search within N results' header, and totalResults JSON all agreeing for each). Sum of the 4 department children (8417+2252+4251+867=15787) is within ~0.1% of the parent total (15766), consistent with 1stDibs' known small cross-tagging overlap (per the prior Furniture-pass access notes for this company) and confirming these 4 are effectively the complete top-level department breakdown, not an arbitrary subset. Deeper third-level cuts also exist under some departments (e.g. /new-arrivals/furniture/lighting/ qty=1145, /new-arrivals/furniture/seating/ qty=1568, /new-arrivals/jewelry/watches/ qty=236) but were not added as separate rows - they are one level deeper than the department split already captured and extracting them would mean re-doing full taxonomy work rather than PLP-level merchandising extraction; noted here for completeness. Also checked and excluded: the 'Now Trending' homepage module is an editorial module, not a New Arrivals listing; site search for 'new arrivals' style terms was not needed since a confirmed nav-linked PLP tree was already found. No Collection-style ambiguity encountered - all pages are plain filterable product grids, not editorial/campaign landing pages.
